propositions: dispatch_one.py (886 LOC) exceeds soft module-size cap (800 LOC) and is on the allowlist/ceilings

Seven non-retrying update_one apply phases (_update_one_apply_reporter, _update_one_filter_fields, _update_one_dispatch_comments, _record_reporter_alert, _jira_account_id_for, _load_alert_store, _OUTBOUND_BATCH_ALLOWLIST) form a cohesive cluster decoupled from _call_with_retry and can be extracted cleanly into a new leaf module

The four retrying phases (_update_one_apply_parent, _update_one_scalar_update, _update_one_dispatch_labels, _update_one_dispatch_links) must remain in dispatch_one.py because they call the shared _call_with_retry backoff hub, and moving them would create bidirectional dependencies

The new dispatch_apply_phases.py leaf module must re-export its three primary phase functions so dispatch_one.update_one bare-name calls and attribute access continue to resolve without breaking back-compat

After extraction, dispatch_one.py must drop to ≤800 LOC and be removed from allowlist/ceilings; arch.md remedy row must be updated or deleted to reflect the non-retrying seam taken instead of the originally named _update_one_apply_parent extraction
